list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 2026-11-18
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it. Every guide below is written in our own words from the official description; where a place or step is not pinned down by the official list we say so plainly. Sources per trophy name Exophase for the official facts, PSNProfiles for PSN progress targets where one exists, and our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is nothing extra to chase. Work through this guide's roadmap in order — story first, then side strands, collectibles, activities and cleanup — and this trophy lands last, automatically.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is unmissable story progress: follow the on-screen objectives through the mission and the trophy pops when it closes.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies are unmissable — keep playing the story in order and this one pops at the chapter's end. Use the roadmap's stage 1 to see which chapter trophies come first.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like the other chapter trophies it cannot be missed — story progress alone earns it, so just keep playing through the chapter in order.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Unmissable story progress: the trophy pops when the chapter's final mission ends, so there is nothing special to prepare — just play the chapter through.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. The last of the chapter trophies, earned by story progress alone. Once it pops, the story trophies left are the individual missions and the finale.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission — the gold story trophy and the natural end of stage 1 of the roadmap. Before you start it, consider clearing the missable trophies first: after the finale, some one-off moments may no longer be available, and the official description does not say which. Not yet checked in the game.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description — missable warning not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. Mission trophies pop at the mission's end, so follow its objectives to completion; no extra requirement is named in the official description.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. As with the other mission trophies, finishing the mission is the whole requirement — play it through and the trophy pops at the end.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. Another mission trophy: finish the mission and it pops. If you are tracking the story in order, this sits in stage 1 of the roadmap with the other mission trophies.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. Finish the mission's objectives to the end and the trophy pops — no side requirement is named in the official description.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. A mission trophy, so completion alone earns it — play the mission through to its end.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. Finish the mission and the trophy pops. The name suggests a heavy-combat mission, but the official description names no extra condition — completion is the requirement.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist. This is the long cleanup trophy: it only lands once the story, side strands, collectibles and activities are all done, so treat it as the last gold before the platinum. Check the game's own stats screen for what still counts toward 100% — the official description does not list the checklist, and we have not verified it in the game yet.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description — the 100% checklist is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, near misses, airtime and the like, as the game counts them. This builds up naturally over a full playthrough, so do not grind it early: drive fast, take jumps whenever you see them, and check the game's stunt counter in stage 4. The official description does not define exactly which moves count, and we have not verified the list in the game yet.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (progress target 250). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — one go at each is enough, no winning required. Sample them as you meet them during the story (races, fishing, shooting range, arcade, bowling, drone races, meditation, hunting and the rest), and use the checklist to tick off the types you have tried. Which 9 the game counts is not pinned down by the official description, so treat the list as our reading of it, not yet checked in the game.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description — the 9 activity types are not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. This is a skill trophy, not a grind: learn one range's timing first, then work through the rest weapon by weapon. Gold medals usually reward accuracy and speed together, so slow down for headshots rather than spraying — but the exact scoring is not in the official description and we have not verified it in the game yet.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (progress target 42). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so you need a win everywhere, not 14 wins in one place. Learn the drone's handling on the easiest course first, then clear the locations one by one — the checklist's stage 4 keeps count.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (progress target 14). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Work through the race types as you unlock them (street, off-road and whatever else the game offers) and tick each new win off in the tracker. Replays of a race you already won do not add to the count.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (progress target 20). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are usually about landing the bigger catch or the better score within the time limit, so bring your best rod and bait and take the challenge when Cal offers it. The exact challenge rules are not in the official description and we have not verified them in the game yet.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — finish a full game at an arcade machine anywhere in Leonida. Any machine and any game counts, so pick the shortest one you find and play it to its end. One completion is all it takes.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission — the end of his mission strand. Side-character strands unlock as the story advances, so keep checking for Andy's missions between story chapters and play each one when it appears. The strand's earlier missions are not trophy-gated, only the last one is.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission, closing out his strand. Work through his missions whenever they show up — the trophy only cares about the last one, but you have to play the earlier ones to reach it.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Like the other character strands, Billy's missions appear as you progress — play them in order when offered and the trophy pops at the strand's end.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as icons on the map — talk to them, play their strand to its end, and count it off. Eight full strands are needed, so do not just sample one mission each: a strand only counts when its final mission is done. Which strangers count toward the 8 is not listed in the official description, so keep a note of the ones you finish.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (progress target 8). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Play his strand through in order as its missions appear, and the trophy pops at the last one.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission, closing his strand. As with the other character strands, the trophy is the strand's last mission — play each of his missions when it shows up.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic places — check clifftops, beaches, parks and overlooks as you explore, and meditate at each one you find. The tracker counts them in stage 3; the exact spot list is not in the official description and we have not verified it in the game yet, so explore widely.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (progress target 18). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a one-off hunt, not regular hunting. Take Bret's mission when it appears, follow the trail to the animal, and make the kill cleanly. The animal's location is not named in the official description and we have not verified it in the game yet.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — pick up every card you spot while exploring, and trade or find the missing ones to finish a set. Three complete sets are needed, so keep collecting past the first set. Card locations are not listed in the official description and we have not verified them in the game yet.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (progress target 3). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. This is the big exploration grind: WAiNK It at every landmark, viewpoint and odd spot you pass, and keep at it through the whole game — 100 distinct locations is a lot, so make it a habit from the start rather than a cleanup chore. The official description does not say which spots qualify, and we have not verified the list in the game yet.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (progress target 100). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind. Challenges stack up from everything else you do — stunts, races, hunts, collectibles — so this one mostly takes care of itself if you play broadly. If it lags behind in stage 4, open the game's challenge list and pick off the easiest unfinished ones.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (progress target 50). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape together. Plan it: pick a quiet stretch of road away from the city centre, get the heat up with your partner in the car, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear. Do it while a partner is available — after the story moves on, partner moments may be harder to set up, and the official description does not say whether it can be done freely after the finale. Flagged missable on that caution.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description — post-finale availability not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without losing your wanted level between them. The trick is the middle part: keep the wanted level alive — do not escape the cops and do not get busted — while you move from shop to shop. Pick three shops close together, plan a fast route, and go in quickly. Do it while partner free-roam is available, since the official description does not promise it stays possible later. Flagged missable on that caution.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description — post-finale availability not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Every new vehicle you get into counts, so drive everything you see — parked cars, bikes, trucks, boats — instead of sticking to one favourite. It builds up fast if you vary your rides through the whole game; the game's vehicle list shows what you have found so far.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (progress target 100). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up: find a group of enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and chain the takedowns before it runs out. A busy shootout with enemies bunched up is the best chance — do not waste it on one or two stragglers.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport — leave VCIA in a way the airport did not schedule. The description reads like a stunt: grab a plane or a fast vehicle at the airport and get out in style. The exact trigger is not spelled out in the official description and we have not verified it in the game yet, so treat our reading as a guess: try taking off from the runway without following the normal route. Flagged missable because a one-off airport stunt may not be repeatable in every story state.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description — the exact trigger is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. The description hints at a hot situation involving Rhino tanks, so expect this to come from a mission or a wanted-level rampage where tanks roll in. Survive the encounter and deal with the tanks however the moment allows; the exact trigger is not spelled out in the official description and we have not verified it in the game yet.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description — the exact trigger is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at all. Go in quiet: move slowly, avoid the staff's line of sight, take what you came for and leave before any alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails — back out and try again rather than fighting through it. Flagged missable because a clean stealth run may be easiest during the story's planned heist window, and the official description does not say it stays repeatable. Not yet checked in the game.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description — repeatability not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults are the big robberies: plan an entry, crack the vault, and get out clean — escaping counts, so do not treat the robbery as done until you are clear of the heat. Five vaults, one at a time, across the game.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (progress target 5). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the roads — stop one, take its cargo, and lose the wanted level that follows. One clean truck robbery is all it takes; pick a quiet road so the escape is easier.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. Drive and fly through every corner of the map — cities, swamps, beaches, backroads — until the map is filled in. It pairs naturally with the collectible hunts in stage 3: use the meditation spots, card hunts and WAiNK It locations as excuses to visit places you have not seen yet.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (progress target 52). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Every gang runs its own operations — find one per gang and hit it. Keep a note of which gangs you have done, since the game will not remind you; the tracker in stage 4 helps you count them off.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (progress target 9). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to a bar or spot on Ocean Beach with a view of the water and order a cocktail — the trophy is about the moment, not a mission. Do it early rather than late: it is a small one-off moment, and the official description does not say it stays available in every story state, so it is flagged missable on that caution. Not yet checked in the game.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description — availability not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through the showroom glass and out the other side. The 'classic style' hints at the old-school GTA showroom smash, so pick a fast car, aim at the glass and do not stop. Flagged missable because showrooms may not all stay smashable after the story moves on, and the exact trigger is not yet checked in the game.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description — the exact trigger is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — follow through on a game there. Any full game counts: show up, bowl your frames and finish the game. It also counts toward trying the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — the description is deliberately vague, and the official list says nothing more. Our reading: it comes from a partner activity that draws a crowd, most likely a story or side moment with your partner. Play the partner content as it appears and it should land on its own; the exact trigger is not yet checked in the game, so we do not invent a location for it.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description — the exact trigger is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks this one up to a count of 500. Choices happen all through the game, in dialogue and in missions, so this builds up slowly over a full playthrough and into cleanup. There is no shortcut named in the official description; keep choosing, and check the PSN counter in stage 4 to see how far along you are.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (progress target 500). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm — succeed at something on your second try. The description reads like a fail-then-succeed moment: fail an attempt at something, then pull it off the next time. It will likely pop on its own during normal play whenever you retry something and nail it; the exact trigger is not in the official description and we have not verified it in the game yet.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description — the exact trigger is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description sounds like a UFO or paranormal easter egg moment. Keep an eye out for odd sights while exploring Leonida at odd hours, especially in remote places. The exact event is not named in the official description and we have not verified it in the game yet, so we do not invent a location for it.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description — the exact event is not yet checked in the game.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — hit a person with a melee swing from a moving vehicle, bowling-pin style. Set it up on a quiet road with a pedestrian nearby: drive past slowly, swing as you pass, and connect. Flagged missable only in the soft sense that drive-by melee chances depend on traffic and wanted level, so grab it when the moment lines up rather than leaving it to the very end.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — pass them through your laundering contacts over time and the total adds up. It is a slow earner, so start laundering early and keep at it through the game rather than saving it for cleanup.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (progress target $250,000). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in the game. Buy clothes, weapons, food, car mods — every shop purchase counts toward the total. It adds up naturally over a full playthrough; if it lags behind in stage 4, spend the surplus on vehicle upgrades, which are useful anyway.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (progress target $100,000). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages go on sale as you explore — buy each one when you find it, and keep the money aside for them instead of spending it all on cars. They double as storage, so they are worth owning anyway.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (progress target 8). Guide: our own advice from the official description.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Whenever you find a vehicle worth keeping, register it in the app instead of just driving it — ten registrations is all it takes. It pairs with Whip It Good's vehicle discovery in stage 3, so register as you discover.
trophies.sources: Exophase (official name, description, grade); PSNProfiles (progress target 10). Guide: our own advice from the official description.
